title: Nomad pairing payload (QR content)
description: Served by the server's LAN-only HTTP UI. Possession of this payload authorizes one pairing (PROTOCOL.md §4).

nodePubkey.description: Server Nostr identity pubkey (secp256k1 x-only, hex).

pairSecret.description: 32 random bytes, base64url. Single-use, expires at exp.

exp.description: Unix timestamp; ≤ 10 minutes after secret creation.
